Beatriz, you attended "Federal Reporting Without the Tears" on April 24, that title says a lot about where your team's energy is going right now.

At roughly 793 students with IEPs, your case managers are likely compiling IDEA Part B data and progress documentation by hand, which turns every reporting cycle into a sprint. Journify sits on top of your existing IEP system and gives the whole team, teachers, case managers, and related-service providers, a shared place to track goal progress and generate compliant documentation in under five minutes per student, so federal reporting stops being a fire drill and your staff's time goes back to kids.

Open to a 20-minute walk-through this week or next?
